card.name: Start of brand names before doses
card.fires_on: The first piece of a biologic or immunology brand name (OTEZLA, ORENCIA, KEVZARA) or the space just before a dose number such as 300 mg or 600 mg, in dosing instructions.

modes.label: Brand name start
modes.description: The opening piece of an upper-case drug brand name used as the object of a dosing instruction.

modes.label: Space before dose number
modes.description: A bare space right before a numeric dose in a regimen or dose comparison.
